arms: Bevacizumab arterial infusion combined with Tislelizumab intrathecal injection

arms: Bevacizumab arterial infusion combined with Tislelizumab intrathecal injection

coder_notes: Both drugs have changed routes: bevacizumab (established GBM therapy) by cerebral arterial infusion = established_therapy_experiment (rule 6, not a candidate); tislelizumab intrathecal off-label = the only investigational agent, so experimental_monotherapy. Mannitol is not a registered intervention but is given to every patient before bevacizumab; the record does not state its purpose, coded delivery_enabling_agent (alternative: supportive). The intervention description also says 'Intrathecal administration of Bevacizumab' (Ommaya), inconsistent with the arm text (arterial infusion). Registry phase is NA.
